title: k-means

plan.insight: Alternate: assign each point to its nearest centroid, move each centroid to its points' mean, until nothing moves.
plan.user_changes: k, drag centroids, click to add points, step/run
plan.reacts: point colors, centroid positions, inertia, iteration count

components.label: k
components.onChange: return { k: value, cents: range(value).map((j) => [1 + j * 1.5, 9]), iter: 0 };
